ValidationRule.description: Block related users from accessing FraudX case based on Coaching Workbench Roles-Based Access Control v1.4. User Sharing Rule might give users undesired access to FraudX case, so need this VR to block.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Fraud', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Identity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'KYC_QA', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Recipient_Mule', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Scam' ), OR( Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Coach', Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Coach_Lead', Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Content_Writer', Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Quality_Analyst' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This user does not have access to FraudX case.
